“Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do…
then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation…
and one male goat, to make atonement for you.
For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of…
For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

translations.web: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
translations.bsb: You shall also prepare one male goat as a sin offering and two male lambs a year old as a peace offering.
translations.kjv: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
translations.asv: And ye shall offer one he-goat for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace-offerings.
